t: State Street® SPDR® Portfolio EM ETF (SPEM)
s: State Street® SPDR® Portfolio EM ETF (SPEM) is a passively managed International Equity Diversified Emerging Mkts exchange-traded fund (ETF). State Street Investment Management launched the ETF in 2007. The investment seeks investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond generally to the total return performance of the S&P Emerging BMI Index.
